title: Build a composable browser probe distribution
result: Bundle the unchanged legacy probe body as a self-contained browser IIFE and load its synchronous default through a lexical wrapper. Build/test scripts generate the asset, package files ship it explicitly, Knip covers authoring entries and Turbo restores generated assets with CLI output. No dependency, sticky behavior, package version or publication changed.
evidence: In the isolated candidate, pinned `pnpm run test` from a missing generated asset passed 491 tests in 122 files with unchanged coverage thresholds: 96.84% statements, 92.01% branches, 95.44% functions and 98.12% lines. Full UI ESLint with `--max-warnings 0`, native TypeScript `--noEmit`, `pnpm run build`, offline pack, canonical Knip comparison and DOM parity passed. The packaged public CLI read the actual shipped asset and captured one synthetic local screen; exit 1 retained three real touch-target findings. Single-package Turbo cache miss/hit/invalidation/restoration passed with byte/mode parity. Independent review found no actionable issue. All ten actual source paths match the tested candidate bytes/modes; npm release, consumer deployment and whole-workspace audit acceptance remain unperformed.
